scope: Diagnostic only; no source-value repair, rescaling, flow admission or trading signal.
rule: BPM6 financial-account balance diagnostic: net acquisition of financial assets minus net incurrence of liabilities.
official_sign_rule: Positive values indicate increases in assets or liabilities; negative values indicate decreases. Financial-account balance is assets minus liabilities.
unit_interpretation: Millions of US dollars: IMF CL_UNIT_MULT code 6 is labelled Millions; the matched CL_INDICATOR labels specify US Dollars. Raw values were not rescaled.
series_semantics_caveat: BFP label is 'Portfolio investment' and does not explicitly say 'balance'. This is a BPM6-consistent reconciliation diagnostic, not proof that BFP is contractually defined as assets minus liabilities.

structural_break.interpretation: A sharp, persistent reconciliation break begins in 2010-01. Cause not established; do not infer whether this is a source methodology break, aggregate-definition difference or data error.
